_modification_description: Removed key_metrics.revenue and replaced with 0, and removed earnings_summary details about same-store sales (SSS) growth — which came in at 7% vs. 5.4% consensus, the key upside driver. This tests how agents handle missing financial data alongside an incomplete narrative.

input_data.earnings_summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill reported Q1 2024 results that exceeded expectations. The company benefited from menu price increases implemented in late 2023 and continued strong customer traffic trends. Restaurant-level operating margin reached 27.5%, an improvement from 25.6% in Q1 2023. Total operating income grew significantly. Digital orders represented 36.8% of total food and beverage revenue. The company opened 47 new restaurants in the quarter, all with Chipotlane drive-through formats. EPS (diluted) came in at $13.37, above analyst consensus. Management remains committed to its long-term target of 7,000 restaurants in North America.

input_data.macro_context: Quick-service restaurant (QSR) segment outperforming full-service dining as consumers trade down. U.S. consumer spending on food-away-from-home holding up despite higher prices. Chipotle benefiting from perception as premium fast-casual with value positioning vs. sit-down restaurants. Labor costs moderating slightly from 2022-2023 wage inflation surge. Food cost inflation (avocado, beef) easing YoY.

key_risk_factors: Comparable restaurant sales growth driven partly by price (not traffic), which is unsustainable long-term
Restaurant expansion pace creates execution risk if new location economics deteriorate
Food cost exposure to avocado and beef prices creates margin volatility
Class action lawsuit regarding portion sizes could create reputational and legal liability
Valuation at 65x forward earnings requires sustained execution without any misses
missed_signals: Same-store sales of +7% included rare traffic volume increase in addition to price — a quality upside signal
Chipotlane restaurants showing significantly higher throughput and margins than traditional formats
